title: Henry Azadehdel's fraudulent South Africa documents

tellings.quote: He he uh published this silver diamonds

plain: A UFO researcher named Clas Svahn talks about a man named Henry Azadehdel, who he says published documents about South Africa. Svahn mentions something he calls "silver diamonds" in connection with them, and he treats the documents as fraudulent. He tells it as a warning about false papers circulating in the UFO world.
